mutations.name: fr1-semantic-check-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Removing the pre-tier semantic refusal lets an invalid switch timestamp validate as strict because both schema backends treat format as an annotation.

mutations.name: fr1-datetime-construction-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Dropping calendar construction admits February 30 and second 60 despite matching the timestamp grammar.

mutations.name: fr1-fullmatch-to-match
mutations._mechanism: A prefix match admits a valid timestamp followed by junk; the zjunk fixture must refuse it.

mutations.name: fr7-property-valid-dict-guard-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Indexing ts without the shared dict guard makes the schema-valid null switch return False through the exception handler instead of True.
